notes:
Migrated to the unified Fact/annotations model (fin/73, transform DFC). Real oracle text (Scryfall-confirmed, data/fin/fin_scryfall.json #73, combined name "Sidequest: Card Collection // Magicked Card"): front "When this enchantment enters, draw three cards, then discard two cards.\nAt the beginning of your end step, if eight or more cards are in your graveyard, transform this enchantment." ({3}{U}, Enchantment); back "Flying\nCrew 1 (Tap any number of creatures you control with total power 1 or more: This Vehicle becomes an artifact creature until end of turn.)" (no mana cost, Artifact — Vehicle, 4/4). Used jill-shiva-s-dominant-shiva-warden-of-ice (freshest, fully-migrated transform DFC, 2026-09-12) as the direct house-style precedent for face/annotation conventions, and magitek-armor/cargo-ship/the-lunar-whale for the real Crew 1 machinery (crewCost+activationCost+effects:[animate], event:'crew'/event:'grantType' facts, the isCrewCostCreatureWant sink exemption).

UNLIKE Jill/Dion/Jecht, this card's own transform is a PLAIN CR 712 face flip ("transform this enchantment") — no "Exile X, then return it to the battlefield transformed" clause, so no zone-change consequence to model with actions.moveTo. saga.ts's transformPermanent generalizes cleanly to this (it just re-registers GameEngine.resolvedPermanents to the new face; its own advanceSaga call correctly no-ops for a non-Saga face like Magicked Card, isSaga() checks the typeLine) — confirmed by actually running it in this card's own real engine-piloted scenario, not just reasoned about.

This is also the FIRST real card in the pool to declare on:'endStep' (ENGINE_GAPS.md gap #3, closed earlier the same day) — checked the whole pool first: Yuna, Hope of Spira/Ultimecia, Time Sorceress (the two cards that gap's own writeup cites) are both still unmigrated. The real intervening-if condition (CR 603.4, "if eight or more cards are in your graveyard") is genuinely checked in definition.ts's own onEndStep run() via ctx.you.getCardsIn('Graveyard').length (real trace evidence: a genuine read:getCardsIn line, count:8, in this card's own trace.json) — not a documentary stand-in. The transform itself has no Fact: no zone movement occurs (see above) and no generic (non-type-filtered) zone card-COUNT Fact vocabulary exists in this model (only type-presence wants like "a Creature card in your graveyard") — genuinely fact-less, flagged as a knownGap, not silently dropped. A piloting caller (this card's own scenarios.ts) calls saga.ts's transformPermanent explicitly once the condition holds, same explicit-signal convention Jill/Dion/Jecht's own front-face transforms already require (no card's own custom effect has a GameEngine reference to call it itself).

6 source + 1 sink fact, all real-annotated via a new annotations-authoring.json + compute-annotations.mjs (7 facts annotated; the crew/grantType spans, oracle line 1 chars 8-74/76-135, are byte-identical to magitek-armor's/cargo-ship's own — same real, verbatim Crew 1 reminder text), value resolved via compute-weights.mjs --slug (all 6 source + 1 sink resolve to the neutral floor, 1 — compute-weights.mjs's own sourceMagnitude has no case for 'drawCard'/'discard'/'grantType' events, same pre-existing limitation qiqirn-merchant's own bigDraw drawCard/magitek-armor's own grantType facts already hit, not something this pass changed).

Front (face:'front'): (1) self-cast {event:'cast', from:'Hand', target:'self'}, typeLine-anchored 'Enchantment'. (2) self-enters {event:'entersBattlefield', to:'Battlefield', target:'self'}, same typeLine anchor. (3) ETB draw {event:'drawCard', controller:'you'}, oracle-anchored 'draw three cards'. (4) ETB discard {event:'discard', controller:'you'}, oracle-anchored 'then discard two cards' — same real drawCard+discard 'loot' shape qiqirn-merchant's own 'cantrip' ability already establishes (discard modeled as a produced SOURCE fact, not cost-shaped, per that card's own precedent). Back (face:'back'): (5) crew-cost {event:'crew', target:'self'}, oracle-anchored 'Tap any number of creatures you control with total power 1 or more'. (6) grantType {event:'grantType', type:'Creature', target:'self', untilEndOfTurn:true}, oracle-anchored 'This Vehicle becomes an artifact creature until end of turn'. Flying — bare printed keyword, no fact (2026-09-12 standing rule, SYNERGY_DESIGN.md — purely passive, no observable occurrence, same treatment cargo-ship's/the-lunar-whale's own bare Flying already get).

Sink (1, back only): creature-to-crew want {to:'Battlefield', controller:'you', types:{has:['Creature']}}, same isCrewCostCreatureWant-exempted shape magitek-armor/cargo-ship/the-lunar-whale already establish. No front-face sink (ETB draw/discard doesn't want anything from another producer).

No baseline self-enters on the back face (Magicked Card never independently 'enters' — it's the SAME permanent object flipping face, not a fresh ETB), matching Jill/Dion's own precedent of a front-face-only baseline.

ONE real, fully engine-piloted scenario (runEngineScenarios, per the task's own '1 default, real basic function' instruction): cast Sidequest: Card Collection ({3}{U} real mana payment) -> real ETB (603.6b auto-fire) draws 3 real cards then discards 2 (graveyard: 6 real seeded FIN cards -- Iron Giant, A Realm Reborn, Relm's Sketching, Fight On!, Wastes, Coeurl, spanning every major card type, standing in for 'whatever else already happened this game' -- plus the 2 just-discarded cards = 8) -> real turn passage (Main1 -> ... -> EndOfTurn, same turn, no draw step crossed) -> on:'endStep' auto-fires for real, genuinely reading the graveyard count (8, logged) -> pilot represents the real transform (saga.ts's transformPermanent) into Magicked Card -> real Crew 1 activation (pilotActivate with a real crewedBy:[Ahriman], a 2-power creature seeded on the battlefield) resolves the real animate effect.

Two real, general (not card-specific-hack) fixes to scripts/verify-synergy.mjs, both surfaced by this card being the first crewCost-on-a-BACK-face / on:'endStep' card in the pool: (1) isCrewCostCreatureWant now checks card?.backFace?.crewCost too (it only ever checked the front-level card.crewCost before, since Magitek Armor/Cargo Ship/The Lunar Whale are all single-faced) — fixed generally, not name-scoped, since any future transform DFC with Crew on its back face would hit the identical gap. (2) new isSidequestCardCollectionGraveyardThresholdRead exemption (reverse aggregate-read check) for the real, genuine ctx.you.getCardsIn('Graveyard') read the onEndStep condition performs — name-scoped (not shape-scoped like isPlayFromLibraryTopPeekRead) because a whole-pool grep confirmed this is currently the ONLY real FIN card with an '[N] or more cards are in your graveyard' clause at all — no second real case to generalize against yet.

verify-synergy.mjs: scoped 0 hard failures (soft notes only: 4x tapForMana, 1x transform, 1x tap-the-crewing-creature — same mechanical-scaffolding class every other engine-piloted DFC/Crew scenario already produces); full pool (320 v2 cards checked, 3 skipped): 0 hard failures. npx vitest run functional-model: 351/351. find-synergies.mjs diff (isolated old-v1-file-vs-new-v2-file swap against the live full pool, filtered to this card's own name): before 9 lines (all illegitimate 'Sidequest: Card Collection --[graveyard presence]-->X' — the old v1 bare-presence SOURCE fact, correctly removed per the no-presence-shaped-source rule); after 131 lines (roughly 119 real 'X --[enters the battlefield/battlefield presence]--> Sidequest: Card Collection' via the new self-cast/self-enters facts matching Battlefield/entersBattlefield-shaped sinks pool-wide, ~11 real 'Sidequest: Card Collection --[enters the battlefield]-->X' via the same self-enters fact satisfying OTHER cards' own generic ETB-payoff wants, 2 real 'Sidequest: Card Collection --[discard]-->X' matches). Zero crew/grantType/creature-want matches yet (new vocabulary on this card's back face, no pool-wide consumer sink exists today) — same 'vocabulary now real, matched later' shape every other fresh vocabulary promotion already established. Net well-understood, same shape as magitek-armor's own 12->152 and cargo-ship's own 35->145 migration diffs.
knownGaps: The 'if eight or more cards are in your graveyard' intervening-if condition (CR 603.4) is genuinely checked in definition.ts's own onEndStep run() (a real board-state read, real trace evidence) but has NO Fact at all — no generic (non-type-filtered) zone card-COUNT Fact vocabulary exists in this model, and the transform consequence itself has no zone movement to anchor a fact to either (a plain CR 712 face flip, unlike Jill/Dion/Jecht's own exile-then-return transforms). Genuinely fact-less, not an oversight.

The RealCard backing self never actually changes its own name/types/subtypes when 'transforming' (no dynamic-transform mechanism exists) — every log entry for this object says 'Sidequest: Card Collection' even after the pilot's own transformPermanent call and the subsequent Crew activation. Pre-existing, same as Jill/Dion/Jecht's own DFCs.
animate/LayerSet tracks no duration (layers.ts's documented scope, pre-existing) — Magicked Card becomes a creature PERMANENTLY in this model rather than 'until end of turn'.

compute-weights.mjs's sourceMagnitude has no case for 'drawCard'/'discard'/'grantType' events, so this card's own draw-3/discard-2/grantType facts all resolve to the neutral floor (1) rather than a real bucketed magnitude — a pre-existing, cross-cutting script gap (also affects qiqirn-merchant's/magitek-armor's/cargo-ship's own identical facts), not something to fix as part of a single-card migration.
